name: holecraft
description: Open-source, offline, browser-based 3D modeling for makers

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace @holecraft/server & npm run dev --workspace @holecraft/web; wait
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @holecraft/web && npm run build --workspace @holecraft/server
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build && npm run build --workspace @holecraft/desktop
scripts.dist:desktop: npm run build:desktop && npm run dist --workspace @holecraft/desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/geometry && tsc -p apps/web && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/desktop
